note: views_cm_current_state adds exactly one Views field handler, current_state_views_field (class CurrentStateViewsField, @ViewsField), registered in views_cm_current_state.views.inc via hook_views_data() on the special global 'views' table under the 'Content revision' group, so it is offered in every view. render() loads each row entity's LATEST revision (getLatestRevisionId/loadRevision) and returns that revision's moderation_state label via content_moderation.moderation_information, falling back to Published/Unpublished. It has no config, no settings form (configure=null), no schema, no permissions, no Drush, and defines no plugin type of its own. In a view config the field is keyed current_state_views_field with table 'views'. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real views config: introspection reads back which view contains the field; execution adds the field to a view's default display, verified against the live views.view config entity.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site using content moderation, I want a Views column that shows each row's current moderation state. The contrib module views_cm_current_state provides it. What is the name/id of the Views field it adds, and under which group does it appear in the Views 'Add field' dialog?
evals.expected_output: It adds a single Views field, 'Current state' (plugin id current_state_views_field), registered via hook_views_data() on the global 'views' table under the 'Content revision' group, so it is available in every view.

evals.prompt: How does the views_cm_current_state 'Current state' field differ from core's 'Moderation state' Views field, and what does it show when the row's entity is not under content moderation?
evals.expected_output: The field loads and reports the entity's LATEST revision's moderation state (e.g. a pending draft/forward revision), whereas core's moderation_state field reflects the loaded default/published revision, so the two can differ. If the latest revision has no moderation_state (entity not moderated) it falls back to 'Published' or 'Unpublished' based on the published flag.

evals.prompt: Which Drupal modules must be enabled for views_cm_current_state to work, and does it add its own configuration form or permissions?
evals.expected_output: It depends on views and content_moderation. It has no configuration form (configure is null), no config schema, no permissions, and no Drush commands; you just add the 'Current state' field to a view.

evals.prompt: This site has a view that already includes the views_cm_current_state 'Current state' field (plugin id current_state_views_field). Inspect the live views configuration and give the machine id of that view.
evals.expected_output: The view is vccs_known: its default display's fields contain a component with plugin_id current_state_views_field (table 'views').

evals.prompt: On this site the view 'vccs_known' shows a current moderation state column via views_cm_current_state. Inspect its configuration: which Views table is that field attached to (the 'table' key of the current_state_views_field component)?
evals.expected_output: The current_state_views_field component in vccs_known uses table: views (the special/global Views table), which is why views_cm_current_state exposes the field to every view.

evals.prompt: This site has a view with machine id 'vccs_task' that currently shows only a Title field. Using the views_cm_current_state module, add its 'Current state' field (plugin id current_state_views_field) to the view's default display and save the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a field component to display.default.display_options.fields of views.view.vccs_task with id/field/plugin_id = current_state_views_field and table = views, then save the view (via the Views UI 'Add field' under 'Content revision', or by editing the view config entity).

evals.prompt: On my site there's a content listing called 'vccs_task' that shows a Title column. I want it to also show the workflow status (draft, published, etc.) of the newest version of each item, the way editors see it. I have the views_cm_current_state module installed. Please add that status column and save it.
evals.expected_output: The correct end state is identical to the expert phrasing: the vccs_task view's default display gains a field component with plugin_id current_state_views_field (the module's 'Current state' field), saved to live config.
